description: Source code for the v1 implementation of the PodResourcesListerServer in Kubernetes, handling listing and retrieving resource information for pods on a node.

classes.name: v1PodResourcesServer
classes.description: Implementation of the PodResourcesListerServer interface for Kubernetes v1, managing pod resource listing and retrieval.

methods.name: NewV1PodResourcesServer
methods.description: Creates a new instance of v1PodResourcesServer, configuring it with providers and feature flags.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns resource information for pods on the node, filtering based on active or all pods.

methods.name: GetAllocatableResources
methods.description: Provides current capacity of resources (devices, CPUs, memory) available on the node.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves resource details for a specific pod identified by namespace and name.

methods.name: getContainerResources
methods.description: Helper method to assemble resource info for a container within a pod.
